recognize_zh: 箭頭指的是一顆巨大的原紅血球母細胞，細胞質深藍色、邊緣有像耳朵般的突起（cytoplasmic bleb），核大而圓、染色質細緻並有深色類核仁包涵體，比旁邊的嗜中性球大好幾倍，符合微小病毒 B19 引起的純紅血球再生不良（PRCA）。
features: Single giant pronormoblast several times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a blunt 'dog-ear' cytoplasmic bleb (arrow)
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and dark nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusion areas
Adjacent mature neutrophils and a band form
Red cells without polychromasia or nucleated red cells in this field
describe_en: Smear shows a giant pronormoblast, several times the size of adjacent neutrophils, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing a prominent cytoplasmic bleb. Its large round nucleus has finely granular chromatin with dark nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions. Nearby cells are mature neutrophils, and no maturing erythroid precursors or polychromatophilic red cells are present in this field. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection causing pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Leukemic proerythroblasts form sheets and often have cytoplasmic vacuoles, while parvovirus giant pronormoblasts are sparse in an erythroid-depleted marrow and confirmed by B19 PCR or immunostain.
Megakaryoblasts show platelet-like cytoplasmic budding and CD41/CD61 expression, and lack glassy intranuclear viral inclusions.
Non-viral PRCA shows an absence of erythroid precursors without giant pronormoblasts bearing intranuclear inclusions.
